chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl bin Ziyad, from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr, from Ibn Uqba, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
From the Sunnah is the trimming of the nails.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on trimming nails according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from al-Kafi anchors the practice of nail trimming within the broader Shia concept of *Fitrah* (natural disposition), linking physical grooming to spiritual purity. It reflects the Prophetic tradition where meticulous care of the body is viewed as an act of worship and adherence to the Sunnah, emphasizing that cleanliness is integral to faith.
